title: The Silence After the Recording Ends

features.name: the listening chair
features.desc-on-touch: you settle into canvas worn smooth by attendance; the headphones rest on the armrest, their spiral cord coiled like a proof of listening that has ended

features.name: the frozen tape deck
features.desc-on-touch: the last recording stopped at exactly this moment; the tape still turns but soundlessly; the counter holds its number like a final word

features.name: the void speaker
features.desc-on-touch: its cone is open but emits nothing; the air around it holds the shape of the last note as if silence could be sculptured

features.name: meters at rest
features.desc-on-touch: the analog needles have fallen to zero; they point downward like prayers nobody made; the calibrations are still readable

features.name: the archive door
features.desc-on-touch: sealed not locked; the hinges remember being opened; the frame holds a draught of air from elsewhere, from when the music was still playing

features.name: the echo chamber wall
features.desc-on-touch: the surface is textured with a thousand small indentations; each one once caught a moment of sound; now they hold only the shape of holding

inscription: the recording ends and you listen for what comes after; it is not silence; it is the place silence returns to, again and again

file.name: Transmission_Ended_Archive_Listening_Session_11Mar.mp3
file.note: a field recording of the moment the playback ceased; the file contains only the last three seconds repeated; checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable

reverie.title: REVERIE — the listening room, last session before the storm
narr: she passes you one side of the headphones; you split
the signal between your ears. the same recording plays
twice, one voice arriving at each temple. you sit very
still. when it ends, neither of you moves. the silence
between you is the same silence the speakers made.

exits.label: downward where the music came from
into the vault where stored silences wait to be answered
to the archive's listening station before the equipment learned to be still
